dataset.name: VocalMind: A Stereotactic EEG Dataset for Vocalized, Mimed, and Imagined Speech in Tonal Language

overt_word_raw_primary.description: Primary article profile: original 1000 Hz vocalized-word sEEG and simultaneous original word WAV; preprocessing must be train-fold-only.

word_transfer_raw_optional.description: Raw primary profile plus original mimed- and imagined-word sEEG for secondary transfer without simultaneous target audio.

overt_word_processed_fidelity.description: Author-processed vocalized-word sEEG and MEL with original audio; baseline fidelity and smoke checks only, not the matched primary result.

word_transfer_processed_fidelity.description: Processed fidelity profile plus mimed- and imagined-word sEEG; secondary smoke/fidelity analysis only.

files.name: Original_Audio_Word.zip
files.role: simultaneous overt word audio at the dataset's original sampling rate

files.name: Original_sEEG_Vocalized_Word.zip
files.role: original 1000 Hz vocalized-word sEEG for the primary fold-safe pipeline

files.name: Original_sEEG_Mimed_Word.zip
files.role: original 1000 Hz mimed-word sEEG for optional transfer analysis

files.name: Original_sEEG_Imagined_Word.zip
files.role: original 1000 Hz imagined-word sEEG for optional transfer analysis

files.name: Processed_Audio_Word.zip
files.role: author-processed 80-bin word MEL targets for fidelity checks

files.name: Processed_sEEG_Vocalized_Word.zip
files.role: author-processed vocalized-word sEEG (stacked HGA and LFS)

files.name: Processed_sEEG_Mimed_Word.zip
files.role: author-processed mimed-word sEEG for optional transfer analysis

files.name: Processed_sEEG_Imagined_Word.zip
files.role: author-processed imagined-word sEEG for optional transfer analysis
